end.summary:
Practised multiplying by 10, 100 and 1000 using place value; all 5 recorded attempts were correct.
Worked on doubling one factor and halving the other for mental multiplication.
Sameer first doubled both factors, then corrected this by halving 16 to 8 and 8 to 4.
Discussed that multiplying by 1 keeps a number the same and multiplying by 0 gives zero.
Introduced rounding 52 to 50 and 38 to 40 for estimation; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Sameer practised place-value multiplication and explained adding zeros in examples such as 36 × 100 and 120 × 10. They used the bags model to understand why one factor doubles while the other is halved; the mix-up of doubling both numbers was corrected later in the lesson. At home, practise a few pairs such as 25 × 16 = 50 × 8 and round two-digit numbers to the nearest ten before estimating.
